'''Blue Jazz''' is a [[Flowers|flower]] that can be [[Crops|grown]] from [[Jazz Seeds]] in 7 days.

If placed within proper range of a [[Bee House#Range|Bee House]] (5 squares in any cardinal direction), Blue Jazz will cause [[Honey|Blue Jazz Honey]] to be produced, increasing the honey base value from {{Price|100}} to {{Price|200}}.

Blue Jazz can be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|50}}.

==Tailoring==
Blue Jazz can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Pants|Skirt]]. [[File:Skirt.png|36px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Blue Jazz is not used in any [[quests]].

==Notes==
*Blue Jazz has an equal chance of being one of six different colors.  Blue Jazz of different colors will occupy different slots in inventory or chests.  Six colors × four [[Crops#Crop Quality|quality]] levels = 24 possible spaces used.
:[[File:BlueJazzColors.png]]
